entities.name: POLG2 mitochondrial
observations: Exact 463-residue sequence match to Xenopus laevis DNA polymerase subunit gamma-2 (UniProt Q9W6G7).
Accessory mitochondrial DNA polymerase subunit; regulates polymerase and exonuclease activities and promotes processive DNA synthesis.
Binds single-stranded DNA and forms a heterotrimer with catalytic POLG and a POLG2 homodimer.
N-terminal residues 1-44 are annotated as a mitochondrial transit peptide; mature chain begins at residue 45.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 52.3 kDa and theoretical pI approximately 8.88.

entities.name: Mitochondrial DNA replication
observations: POLG2 supports mitochondrial DNA replication by increasing POLG processivity and DNA-template interaction.
POLG2 allosterically regulates POLG polymerase and exonuclease activities.

entities.name: Mitochondrial matrix
observations: POLG2 is localized to the mitochondrial matrix and mitochondrial nucleoid as part of the gamma DNA polymerase complex.

entities.name: Gamma DNA polymerase complex
observations: Heterotrimer consisting of catalytic POLG and a homodimer of POLG2 accessory subunits.
